Jab suraj lapet diya jaye ga.
Aur jab sitare toot toot kar grin ge.
Aur jab paharon ko chalaya jaye ga.
Aur jab dus mahine ki gabhn aontnion ko bhi bekar chhor diya jaye ga.
Aur jab wehshi jaanwar akthe krdie jayen ge.
Aur jab samandaron ko bhrkaia jaye ga.
Aur jab logon ke jore jo te bana die jayen ge.
Aur jis bacchi ko zinda qabar mein gaar diya gaya tha, us se pochha jaye ga.
Ke use kis jurm mein qatal kya gaya ?
Aur jab aemaal name khol die jayen ge.
Aur jab aasman ka chhlka utaar diya jaye ga.
Aur jab dozakh bharkai jaye gi.
Aur jab jannat qareeb kardi jaye gi.
To us waqt har shaks ko apna sara kiya dhara maloom hojaye ga.
Ab mein qasam khata hon un sitaron ki jo peechhe ki taraf chalne lagte hain.
Jo chalte chalte dubak jate hain.
Aur qasam khata hon raat ki jab woh rukhsat ho.
Aur subah ki jab woh saans le.
Ke yeh (quran) yaqeeni tor par ek muazzaz farishte ka laya hua kalaam hai.
Jo qooat wala hai, jis ka arsh wale ke paas bara rutba hai.
Wahan us ki baat maani jati hai. Woh amanat daar hai.
Aur (ae makkah walo) tumhare saath rehne wale yeh sahib (yani hazrat Muhammad (sli Allah alh waala wasalam) koi deewane nahin hain.
Aur yeh bilkul sachi baat hai ke unhon ne us farishte ko khle hue ufuq par dekha hai.
Aur woh gaib ki baaton ke bare mein bakheel bhi nahin hain.
Aur na yeh (quran) kisi mardood shetan ki (banaee hui) koi baat hai.
Phir bhi tum log kidhar chale jarahe ho ?
Yeh to duniya jahaan ke logon ke liye ek naseehat hai.
Tum mein se har us shaks ke liye jo seedha seedha rehna chahaye.
Aur tum chaho ge nahin, illa yeh ke khud Allah chahaye jo sare jahano ka Parwardigar hai.
